title: Certify recursive invoice comparisons at exact rational powers
body:
Concave order can be inconclusive even when a proposed power tariff has a strict sign. Add a separate bounded comparator for `r^t`, where t is an exact fraction or decimal. Integer square roots and directed integer products produce rational cost bounds; an interval containing zero stays unresolved. Equal rank terms cancel before interval work.

Use `python3 -B scripts/evaluate_recursive_power.py OLD.json NEW.json --exponent 0.9969`. The linked guide gives the full rounding argument, parameter limits and omitted construction/κ obligations. Existing comparator bytes are unchanged; this PR does not depend on PR5731.

Validation: 8 tests pass normally and under `-O`. Independent integer-power inequalities check 216 rank/exponent cases; controls cover exact roots, signed target debits, large-denominator decimals, resource limits after cancellation, 512 ranks at maximum counts/precision, and the real `-I -O` CLI. `git diff --check` passes.

Current main/priorities and live PR/Discussion overlap checked. The guide link is in a separate section from PR5731. This certifies declared invoice arithmetic at one exponent, not a complete κ. Hosted CI is pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `75aaaa5b0c6c7ebd5a0c8c61222208787fe076b4`.
